pad.title: The Problem We Solve
pad.body: Intercontinental trade between developing economies remains plagued by institutional silos, regulatory misalignment, and the absence of trusted diplomatic intermediaries. South American exporters cannot reliably reach Middle Eastern buyers. African infrastructure projects lack access to BRICS capital flows. TCA was founded to dismantle these barriers — replacing friction with structured, trust-based cooperation corridors that unlock real economic value across hemispheres.
pad.vision: A world where developing economies trade seamlessly across continents — not because borders disappeared, but because institutions learned to cooperate across them.

content.body: Intercontinental trade between developing economies remains plagued by institutional silos, regulatory misalignment, and the absence of trusted diplomatic intermediaries. events.title: Foundation of TCA
events.description: Established as a diplomatic and institutional bridge organisation focused on facilitating trade between South America and the Middle East, with BRICS integration as the strategic horizon.

events.title: First Bilateral Protocol: Brazil–UAE
events.description: Signed the first TCA-mediated bilateral cooperation protocol between Brazilian agricultural exporters and UAE import institutions — establishing the template for all subsequent corridor agreements.

events.title: BRICS Alignment Declaration
events.description: Formalised TCA's role as an independent facilitation body aligned with BRICS cooperation objectives, gaining observer status at the BRICS Business Council trade working group.

events.title: Africa Corridor Expansion
events.description: Launched the Africa–Middle East Agricultural Belt corridor in partnership with the African Union trade office, extending TCA's operational footprint to 12 sub-Saharan economies.

events.title: Digital Trade Infrastructure Pilot
events.description: Deployed the first smart contract settlement framework on the Brazil–Gulf corridor, processing $42M in cross-border transactions without correspondent banking intermediaries.

events.title: South Atlantic Energy Corridor
events.description: Activated the Russia–South America energy cooperation corridor, connecting Brazilian and Argentine energy producers with Russian technology and infrastructure partnerships under BRICS development frameworks.

events.title: 10-Corridor Network Milestone
events.description: Reached 10 active intercontinental trade corridors under TCA institutional management, covering $1.8B in facilitated annual trade volume across 31 participating countries.

profile.default_description: A diplomatic and economic alliance bridging continents — facilitating cooperation between developing markets and the Middle East, advancing BRICS integration and transcontinental trade.

page_seo.title: Home
page_seo.description: Developing economies lose billions annually to fragmented cross-border processes, incompatible regulatory frameworks, and the absence of institutional bridges. TCA closes that gap — forging structured cooperation channels between South America, Africa, the Middle East, and BRICS-aligned markets.

page_seo.title: The Alliance
page_seo.description: An independent institutional body dedicated to building the diplomatic, regulatory, and commercial infrastructure that makes intercontinental trade between developing economies viable, scalable, and sovereign.

page_seo.title: Programs
page_seo.description: Structured, time-bound engagements designed to activate intercontinental trade corridors, facilitate BRICS market access, and deploy digital trade infrastructure for developing economy enterprises and institutions.

page_seo.title: Contact
page_seo.description: Reach TCA's institutional facilitation team to discuss trade corridor opportunities, program eligibility, or partnership development across BRICS-aligned and intercontinental markets.
